key.name: pointer-reveal
key.summary: When moving the pointer shows the bar
key.description: "anywhere": any movement over the fullscreen player, as VLC's own controller does. "edge": only near the edge of its monitor the bar is on (bar-position). "never": only the keyboard shortcut, a controller or the player pausing shows it.

key.name: bar-position
key.summary: Which edge of the screen the bar is on
key.description: "bottom", where the shell's own pop-ups sit, or "top", which keeps it clear of subtitles along the foot of the picture.

key.name: hide-delay
key.summary: Seconds before the bar hides again
key.description: Counted from the last pointer movement or action. The bar stays while the pointer is on it or it holds the keyboard.

key.name: stay-while-paused
key.summary: Keep the bar up while paused

key.name: seek-step
key.summary: Seconds skipped by Skip back and Skip forward

key.name: volume-step
key.summary: Percent of volume per Volume up or Volume down

key.name: bar-scale
key.summary: Size of the bar, in percent
key.description: Scales the whole bar and its pop-out together, for a screen seen from across a room.

key.name: previous-next
key.summary: When the Previous and Next buttons are on the bar
key.description: "always" (greyed out when there is nothing to go to), "playlist": only while the player says it can go back or on, or "never".

key.name: hidden-buttons
key.description: Any of "skip" (Skip back and forward), "volume" (mute and the volume slider), "rate" (the speed) and "close". What they do is still there for the keyboard and the controllers.

key.name: show-clock
key.summary: Show the time, and when the video ends
key.description: A line under the title: the time now, and the time the video will end at the current speed.

key.name: sleep-timer
key.summary: Show a sleep timer on the bar
key.description: A button that pauses the player after a while (sleep-timer-mode); each press moves to the next step, and one more turns it off.

key.name: sleep-timer-mode
key.description: "minutes": 15, 30, 45, 60, 90 or 120 of them, then the end of the file. "episodes": 1 to 5 files, pausing at the end of the last; each new file the player moves on to is one.

key.name: toggle-bar
key.summary: Show the bar with the keyboard
key.description: Opens the bar holding the keyboard: the arrow keys move between its buttons, Enter presses one, Escape or the shortcut again puts it away.

key.name: ignored-players
key.summary: Players the bar is never shown over
key.description: Lower-case names, matched against every name a player goes by: its desktop entry, its identity, and its bus name without the per-instance part (Chrome is "chromium" there). The browsers are here by default: a fullscreen video in one draws its own controls.

key.name: gamepads
key.description: Pads are read through libmanette and never grabbed; a button does something only while a fullscreen player is focused.

key.name: ignored-gamepads
key.description: SDL GUIDs, as the preferences list them. A GUID names a model, not a single pad.

key.name: gamepad-buttons
key.description: Button ids and action ids from lib/actions.js. A button missing from the map does nothing. While the bar holds the focus (after "navigate"), the d-pad and the bottom and right buttons move around it instead.
